summary: Titanium Oyj engages in the provision of investment and asset management services in Finland. The company offers investment solutions in the areas of fund operations. It also provides investment advice and brokerage; investment-linked insurance; financial management for individuals; corporate asset management; and institutional financial management services, as well as operates My Titanium, a customer portal that offers customers a centralized overview of their investments. It serves private, institutional, and corporate customers. Titanium Oyj was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Helsinki, Finland.
